review.notes: Full review of the README and Suggested.lean. Adversarial table of 28 rows with computed values. About 50 cross-roadmap ids resolved on main and at the heads of #2893 and #1804; one supplier drift (AlgebraicTopology Stage 8). Dependency check: 7 roadmaps, 120 edges, 0 problems. The worker's automatic checks all passed. lake env lean on Suggested.lean: sorry the only warning; elaborated signature matches the README; one-tactic probe closes nothing.
